name: erc1155_patterns
description: Missing array length validation in ERC-1155 batch mint/transfer functions
question: The source file in `source` defines a custom ERC-1155 batch minting or batch transfer function that loops over an `ids` array and a separate `amounts` (or `values`) array using a shared index, without first requiring that both arrays have equal length, so mismatched array lengths let indices pair incorrectly and mint or transfer wrong token amounts, or cause unhandled out-of-bounds reverts, rather than merely relying on trusted owner-only access.
criteria: Custom function like `mintBatch` or `safeBatchTransferFrom` override loops with `for (uint256 i = 0; i < ids.length; i++)`
Loop body indexes a second array such as `amounts[i]` or `values[i]` without validating it has the same length as `ids`
No `require(ids.length == amounts.length, ...)` or equivalent length-equality check before the loop
Function is externally/publicly callable and performs `_mint`, `_mintBatch`, or token transfer logic based on the mismatched arrays
Absence of reliance on OpenZeppelin's internal `_mintBatch`/`_update` length checks (i.e., custom loop bypasses them)
